  <section v="3">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains the two levels of Malchus represented by "Nasan" and "Dovid," and how the phrase "Vayomer Lo Yehonasan" connects them, analogous to the splitting of the sea.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">2)</t>
    <t s="1">And the maamar continues,</t>
    <t s="2">that Yehonasan is Yeihu Nasan,</t>
    <t s="3">and it is brought in Ma’orei Or</t>
    <t s="4">that Nasan in gematria is 500, which is the final Hei of the Name Havayah,</t>
    <t s="5">for Hei multiplied [by itself] equals 500 in gematria.</t>
    <t s="6">And the maamar clarifies,</t>
    <t s="7">that according to the explanation that in most places Yehonasan is Yeihu</t>
    <t s="8">[and Nasan</t>
    <t s="9">(in Yehonasan)</t>
    <t s="10">is that the Yeihu are in the aspect of giving and drawing down],</t>
    <t s="11">the meaning of "Vayomer lo Yehonasan" is understood.</t>
    <t s="12">Yehonasan,</t>
    <t s="13">the drawing down from Yehonasan to Dovid,</t>
    <t s="14">that the Yeihu of Yehonasan are drawn down to Malchus,</t>
    <t s="15">Dovid.</t>
    <t s="16">But according to the explanation of the Ma’orei Or that Nasan in Yehonasan is the final Hei,</t>
    <t s="17">which is Malchus,</t>
    <t s="18">what is the concept of "Vayomer lo"?</t>
    <t s="19">Yehonasan</t>
    <t s="20">(the drawing down of Yehonasan to Dovid),</t>
    <t s="21">for Nasan of Yehonasan and Dovid are seemingly the same thing.</t>
    <t s="22">And he explains,</t>
    <t s="23">that in Malchus there are two levels.</t>
    <t s="24">As it is the end of Atzilus</t>
    <t s="25">(the tail of the lions),</t>
    <t s="26">and as it is the source for Biyah</t>
    <t s="27">(the head of the foxes).</t>
    <t s="28">And this is the difference between Nasan</t>
    <t s="29">(of Yehonasan)</t>
    <t s="30">and Dovid,</t>
    <t s="31">that Nasan, which is the final Hei of the Name Havayah</t>
    <t s="32">(as above),</t>
    <t s="33">is Malchus as it is the end of Atzilus,</t>
    <t s="34">and Dovid is Malchus as it is the source for Biyah.</t>
    <t s="35">And the concept of "Vayomer lo Yehonasan" is the drawing down of Malchus as it is in Atzilus</t>
    <t s="36">(Nasan,</t>
    <t s="37">the final Hei.</t>
    <t s="38">And through this – also the drawing down of Yeihu)</t>
    <t s="39">into the Malchus that is the source for Biyah</t>
    <t s="40">(Dovid).</t>
    <t s="41">And the maamar adds,</t>
    <t s="42">that the two aspects in Malchus are called by the names Sea and Land.</t>
    <t s="43">Sea</t>
    <t s="44">is Malchus as it is in Atzilus,</t>
    <t s="45">into which the Sefiros of Z’a that are above Malchus are drawn – all the rivers flow to the sea.</t>
    <t s="46">And because Malchus receives and gathers within itself the Sefiros that are above it – it conceals them,</t>
    <t s="47">like the sea which covers what is within it.</t>
    <t s="48">And through this</t>
    <t s="49">Malchus is drawn to become the source for bringing creatures into being – the aspect of Land,</t>
    <t s="50">"Let the earth sprout… Let the earth bring forth…".</t>
    <t s="51">And he explains,</t>
    <t s="52">that the concept of "Vayomer lo Yehonasan" is like the matter of turning the sea into dry land</t>
    <t s="53">which occurred at the Splitting of the Red Sea.</t>
    <t s="54">That is,</t>
    <t s="55">in addition to the drawing down of Malchus as it is in Atzilus</t>
    <t s="56">(Nasan,</t>
    <t s="57">the final Hei)</t>
    <t s="58">which was drawn into the aspect of Malchus as it is the source for Biyah</t>
    <t s="59">(Dovid),</t>
    <t s="60">there was also the matter of turning the sea into dry land,</t>
    <t s="61">that the concealment was split</t>
    <t s="62">(sea)</t>
    <t s="63">and the lights of the Sefiros of Atzilus were revealed</t>
    <t s="64">(which are in Malchus)</t>
    <t s="65">as they are in their very essence.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="4">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that after Dovid received the essence of the lights of Atzilus, the subsequent descent for birurim (the "Segol") leads to the elevation of "Segulta" and "Segulah."</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And the maamar continues,</t>
    <t s="1">that after Dovid received the statement and words of Yehonasan</t>
    <t s="2">(meaning that the essential lights of Atzilus were drawn into him),</t>
    <t s="3">then</t>
    <t s="4">he said to him,</t>
    <t s="5">"And you shall go down three, very much,"</t>
    <t s="6">and "three" is</t>
    <t s="7">that there will be made an aspect of Segol</t>
    <t s="8">(which has three dots)</t>
    <t s="9">which alludes to the work of birurim</t>
    <t s="10">(that is, the descent of Malchus below to clarify birurim),</t>
    <t s="11">and through this there will be "and you shall go down three,"</t>
    <t s="12">the aspect of Segulta</t>
    <t s="13">(for in Segulta there are also three dots),</t>
    <t s="14">the aspect of Segulah.</t>
    <t s="15">As it is written,</t>
    <t s="16">"And you shall be a treasure to Me from among all the nations,"</t>
    <t s="17">for through the birur that one clarifies from all the nations,</t>
    <t s="18">through this "you shall be a treasure to Me."</t>
    <t s="19">And seemingly,</t>
    <t s="20">this that Yehonasan said to Dovid "and you shall go down three, very much"</t>
    <t s="21">[that through the descent to the aspect of Segol to clarify birurim</t>
    <t s="22">he will be elevated to the aspect of Segulta and Segulah],</t>
    <t s="23">is in general one matter with that which he said to him initially, "and you will be missed, for your seat will be vacant,"</t>
    <t s="24">for through "your seat will be vacant"</t>
    <t s="25">(descent and concealment)</t>
    <t s="26">there will be "and you will be missed."</t>
    <t s="27">[Except that initially he told him the matter in general,</t>
    <t s="28">and afterwards he added details to this,</t>
    <t s="29">both regarding the descent – "and you shall go down three, very much… and you shall sit by the stone Ezel,"</t>
    <t s="30">the descent into the world of Asiyah,</t>
    <t s="31">and regarding the elevation that comes through the descent – "and you shall go down three,"</t>
    <t s="32">that he will be elevated to the aspect of Segulta and Segulah].</t>
  </section>
  <section v="5">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains why the haftarah of "Mechar Chodesh" begins with "Vayomer lo Yehonasan," as the initial drawing down of the lights of Atzilus enables the subsequent descent and concealment of the moon.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">3)</t>
    <t s="1">And one must understand why the beginning of the haftarah of "Mechar Chodesh" is "Vayomer lo Yehonasan,"</t>
    <t s="2">for seemingly,</t>
    <t s="3">the content of the haftarah of "Mechar Chodesh" is,</t>
    <t s="4">that in order for there to be the birth of the moon</t>
    <t s="5">(Malchus)</t>
    <t s="6">there must first be</t>
    <t s="7">(on the eve of Rosh Chodesh)</t>
    <t s="8">the descent and concealment</t>
    <t s="9">("your seat will be vacant,"</t>
    <t s="10">"you shall go down very much… by the stone Ezel"),</t>
    <t s="11">and the concept of "Vayomer lo Yehonasan" at the beginning of the haftarah is</t>
    <t s="12">(on the contrary)</t>
    <t s="13">the ultimate perfection of Malchus</t>
    <t s="14">(the source of Biyah),</t>
    <t s="15">that the aspect of Malchus of Atzilus and also the attributes of Z’a shine within it in revelation</t>
    <t s="16">(as above, section 2).</t>
    <t s="17">And the point of the explanation is,</t>
    <t s="18">that in order for there to be the matter of "your seat will be vacant"</t>
    <t s="19">[and in a way that through this there will be "and you will be missed"]</t>
    <t s="20">it is through a drawing down from above.</t>
    <t s="21">And this is that the beginning of the haftarah</t>
    <t s="22">[even before the words "Mechar Chodesh" are said]</t>
    <t s="23">is "Vayomer lo Yehonasan,"</t>
    <t s="24">that initially there is drawn into Malchus</t>
    <t s="25">(the source of Biyah)</t>
    <t s="26">the lights of Atzilus,</t>
    <t s="27">and through this</t>
    <t s="28">it is possible afterwards for the matter of "Mechar Chodesh"</t>
    <t s="29">– the descent and concealment of the moon,</t>
    <t s="30">"your seat will be vacant"</t>
    <t s="31">(the concept of the eve of Rosh Chodesh,</t>
    <t s="32">"tomorrow is the new month"),</t>
    <t s="33">and after this</t>
    <t s="34">(on Rosh Chodesh)</t>
    <t s="35">– "and you will be missed."</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
